title: On the induction functor from group algebras to distribution algebras
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive algebraic group scheme defined over ${\mathbb F}_{p}$ and $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$. There are two associated families of finite group schemes, the $r$-th Frobenius kernels, denoted by $G_r$, and the fixed points of the iterated Frobenius map, the finite groups of Lie type, denoted by $G(\mathbb{F}_q).$ Bendel, Nakano and Pillen initiated the investigation of the induction functor $\operatorname{ind}_{G(\mathbb{F}_q)}^G-$. Using filtrations and truncation, large amounts of data coming from the algebraic group and the Frobenius kernels…
